User.title: User
User.description: Authenticated REXON HR Management System user with RBAC role, branch scope, and assigned sites.

assignedBranches.description: Authorized branch IDs for multi-branch HR users.

assignedSiteIds.description: Bounded list of authorized site IDs (max 50).

permissions.description: Bounded list of granular dot-notation permission strings (max 60).

Employee.title: Employee
Employee.description: Operational REXON Employee record with dynamic service/designation assignments, document verification rollup, and soft-delete preservation. Zero sensitive Aadhaar/PAN/Bank/Salary fields.

assignedDesignations.description: Structured designation assignments with eligibility verification.

EmployeePrivate.title: EmployeePrivate
EmployeePrivate.description: Isolated sensitive KYC, Bank, and Salary records strictly hidden from Site Portal and Field Officer roles.

EmployeeDocument.title: EmployeeDocument
EmployeeDocument.description: Employee KYC & qualification document metadata linked to private Firebase Storage objects with Pending/Verified/Rejected workflow.

EmployeeHistory.title: EmployeeHistory
EmployeeHistory.description: Immutable chronological trail of Employee Designation changes, Site Assignments, and Profile/Document activities.

Branch.title: Branch
Branch.description: Master Branch record managed exclusively by Administrators with soft-delete support.

HRProfile.title: HRProfile
HRProfile.description: HR account profile provisioned via Firebase Authentication without storing plain-text passwords.

permissions.description: Bounded list of dot-notation HR permission keys (max 60).

Client.title: Client
Client.description: Contracted Client organization master record supporting multiple Sites.

Site.title: Site
Site.description: Deployment Site record linked to one parent Client with historical preservation.

allowedRadiusMeters.description: Allowed GPS check-in radius in meters (20 to 5000).

gpsAccuracyThresholdMeters.description: Max acceptable device GPS uncertainty in meters.

isGpsMandatory.description: Whether GPS geofence verification is mandatory for site check-in.

isQrEnabled.description: Whether rotating Shift QR check-in is enabled for this site.

Service.title: Service
Service.description: Dynamic REXON Service catalog record under Security, Housekeeping, or Manpower.

Designation.title: Designation
Designation.description: Extensible Designation record linked to a Service Category and Related Service without code changes.

SiteService.title: SiteService
SiteService.description: Site-level Service & Designation configuration enforcing non-negative vacancy counts (Vacant = Required - Deployed).

Approval.title: Approval
Approval.description: Sensitive HR action approval request routed to Administrator queue (Pending, Approved, Rejected, Cancelled).

AuditLog.title: AuditLog
AuditLog.description: Immutable append-only operational and security audit log across all Phase 2, Phase 3 & Phase 4 modules.

EmployeeAssignment.title: EmployeeAssignment
EmployeeAssignment.description: Employee site deployment & shift roster record supporting multiple assignments, future scheduling, and inter-site transfer lineage.

AssignmentHistory.title: AssignmentHistory
AssignmentHistory.description: Append-only assignment lifecycle history (Assigned, Transferred, Modified, Ended, Cancelled, FO Actions, Approvals).

ManpowerShortage.title: ManpowerShortage
ManpowerShortage.description: Field Officer / HR site manpower shortage alert and fulfillment tracker.

SiteDeploymentSummary.title: SiteDeploymentSummary
SiteDeploymentSummary.description: Sanitized zero-PII site manpower summary readable by Site Portal accounts for their own assignedSiteIds.

DutyRoster.title: DutyRoster
DutyRoster.description: Daily, Weekly, or Monthly employee shift schedule supporting overnight shifts across midnight, capacity checks, and publish notifications.

Attendance.title: Attendance
Attendance.description: Operational employee shift attendance record verified via one-shot GPS geofence, rotating Shift QR, or HR manual override. Strictly hidden from Site Portal.

AttendanceCorrection.title: AttendanceCorrection
AttendanceCorrection.description: Missing punch, geofence exception, and attendance correction request routed to authorized HR or Admin.

SiteQrSession.title: SiteQrSession
SiteQrSession.description: Time-limited HMAC-signed rotating Shift QR session containing zero employee PII.

EmployeeNotification.title: EmployeeNotification
EmployeeNotification.description: Targeted employee notification emitted on duty roster publication/changes, attendance verification, correction review, or overtime approval.

AttendanceAuditLog.title: AttendanceAuditLog
AttendanceAuditLog.description: Immutable append-only audit log for Duty Roster changes, Attendance overrides, Geofence/QR events, Corrections, and Overtime reviews.

SanitizedSiteAttendanceSummary.title: SanitizedSiteAttendanceSummary
SanitizedSiteAttendanceSummary.description: Date-wise headcount-only site attendance summary for Site Portal accounts — strictly ZERO employee names, phone numbers, KYC, salary, or GPS coordinates.

ShiftMaster.title: ShiftMaster
ShiftMaster.description: Reusable shift master configuration supporting General, Morning, Evening, Night (midnight-crossing), Day, Rotational, and Custom shifts.

AttendanceException.title: AttendanceException
AttendanceException.description: Field Officer and HR site attendance monitoring reports (Missing Attendance, Attendance Issue, Site Visit Report, Employee Replacement Requirement) with optional site photo.

AttendanceApproval.title: AttendanceApproval
AttendanceApproval.description: Admin approval workflow for site geofence radius overrides requested by HR.

/users/{uid}.description: Master RBAC user profiles across Admin, HR, Field Officer, Site, and Employee portals.

/employees/{employeeId}.description: Operational employee records with dynamic designation checks and zero sensitive PII.

/employeePrivate/{employeeId}.description: Strictly isolated employee Aadhaar, PAN, Bank, and Salary details hidden from Site and Field Officer portals.

/employeeDocuments/{documentId}.description: Employee KYC & qualification documents stored privately in Firebase Storage with verification status.

/employeeHistory/{historyId}.description: Append-only employee Designation, Site Assignment, and Activity history.

/branches/{branchId}.description: Operational branches managed exclusively by Admin.

/hrProfiles/{hrId}.description: HR master accounts and permission profiles provisioned via Firebase Auth and trusted backend.

/clients/{clientId}.description: Contracted client organizations managed by authorized HR and Admin.

/sites/{siteId}.description: Deployed client sites linked to clients/{clientId} and scoped by branchId and assignedSiteIds.

/services/{serviceId}.description: Dynamic Security, Housekeeping, and Manpower master service catalog.

/designations/{designationId}.description: Dynamic designations linked to services/{serviceId} with qualification, training, and license criteria.

/siteServices/{siteServiceId}.description: Multi-service site manpower configurations enforcing non-negative vacancy calculations.

/approvals/{approvalId}.description: Sensitive HR action approval workflow queue reviewed by Administrators.

/auditLogs/{logId}.description: Immutable append-only security, permission, approval, and master data audit trail.

/employeeAssignments/{assignmentId}.description: Employee site assignments, shifts, upcoming rosters, and inter-site transfer lineage.

/assignmentHistory/{historyId}.description: Append-only chronological history of all site assignment, transfer, remark, and approval events.

/manpowerShortages/{shortageId}.description: Field Officer and HR site manpower shortage reports and fulfillment statuses.

/siteDeploymentSummaries/{siteId}.description: Sanitized zero-PII site manpower and shift deployment summary for Site Portal.

/dutyRosters/{rosterId}.description: Daily, Weekly, and Monthly shift duty rosters with overnight shift support and sanctioned capacity enforcement.

/attendance/{recordId}.description: Operational employee attendance records verified via GPS geofence, rotating Shift QR, or HR override (never readable by Site Portal).

/attendanceCorrections/{correctionId}.description: Missing punch, geofence exception, and attendance correction workflow queue.

/attendanceQrSessions/{sessionId}.description: Time-limited rotating site shift QR verification sessions with zero employee PII.

/employeeNotifications/{notificationId}.description: Employee roster & attendance notifications scoped strictly to the target employee and authorized HR/Admin.

/attendanceAuditLogs/{auditId}.description: Immutable append-only audit trail for all Phase 4 Duty Roster and Attendance mutations.

/siteAttendanceSummaries/{summaryId}.description: Sanitized headcount-only daily site turnout summaries readable by Site Portal for assignedSiteIds.

/shifts/{shiftId}.description: Shift master definitions supporting standard, rotational, and overnight midnight-crossing schedules.

/attendanceExceptions/{exceptionId}.description: Field Officer site attendance monitoring & visit reports resolved by HR/Admin.

/attendanceApprovals/{approvalId}.description: Site geofence radius override approval requests reviewed by Admin.
